title: The Meghalaya Heritage Act, 2012 (Act No. 9 of 2012)
full_text: The Meghalaya Heritage Act, 2012 (Act No. 9 of 2012) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20129 Act Number: 9 Enactment Date: 2012-04-03 Act Year: 2012 Short Title: The Meghalaya Heritage Act, 2012 (Act No. 9 of 2012) Long Title: An Act to provide for conservation and protection of heritage sites which shall include buildings, artefacts, structures,areas, streets and precincts of historic or cultural or environmental significance (heritage buildings and heritage precincts) and natural features of environmental significance and sites of scenic beauty and also to provide for conservation and protection of areas of environmental sensitivity.
